with s as (select market_ticker, date_trunc('day',at) d from incentive_market_snapshots where at > now()-interval '14 days' group by 1,2)
select case
 when market_ticker ~ '^KX(GOLD|SILVER|COPPER)EVENT' then 'metal_event'
 when market_ticker ~ '^KX(AUDUSD|USDJPY|GBPUSD|USDMXN|USDCAD|EURUSD)EVENT' then 'fx_event'
 when market_ticker ~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|HYPE)EVENT' then 'crypto_event'
 when market_ticker ~ '^KX(SENATENOM|GOVNOM|DPRESPRIMARY|RPRESPRIMARY|AGRACE|TREASRACE|SOSRACE|AUDITORRACE)' then 'nom_race'
 when market_ticker ~ '^KX(GENERALCOUNTY|STATEBALLOTMEASURE)' then 'study5_leads'
 when market_ticker ~ '^KXRT' then 'rt'
 else 'other' end fam, count(distinct market_ticker) mkts, count(*) mkt_days,
 min(d)::date first_day
from s group by 1 order by 1
